vBRIEFInfo.author: Scott
vBRIEFInfo.description: Wave 1 coordinated implementation for #2013 (#1502 + #2005) plus urgent #2049 consumer githooks TS-native fix

plan.title: #2013 Wave 1 — PROJECT-DEFINITION export + migration fidelity gate

narratives.Description: Implements locked Wave 0 decisions: two-path spec authority, three-class banner/predicate, project:export-spec with audience-split proposed scopes, config-narrative filtering, and #2005 migration-fidelity gate blocking silent specification.xbrief.json deletion.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) packages/core spec-authority resolver + export-spec render path. 2) precutover + validate-strategy-output three-class predicates (TS + Python). 3) migration fidelity when premigrate snapshot exists without canonical landing. 4) Wire CLI/task project:export-spec; spec:render delegates. 5) Tests + skill/doc touch-ups.
narratives.UserStory: As a greenfield setup operator, I can export SPECIFICATION.md from PROJECT-DEFINITION without creating forbidden specification.xbrief.json, and agents cannot pass verify-strategy-output after deleting spec content without migration proof.

items.title: Greenfield PROJECT-DEFINITION export produces SPECIFICATION.md with PD source banner and Scope outlook sections

narrative.Acceptance: Given a v0.20 tree with PROJECT-DEFINITION, lifecycle folders, proposed+pending scopes, and no specification.xbrief.json, when project:export-spec runs, then SPECIFICATION.md is generated with the PD source-of-truth banner, filtered config narratives, and pending scopes; proposed scopes appear only with --audience=internal.

items.title: Three-class precutover and strategy-output predicates recognize full-spec and greenfield exports

narrative.Acceptance: Given full-spec and greenfield fixture trees, when verify-strategy-output and precutover helpers run, then each class is recognized without cross-classifying greenfield exports as legacy hand-authored SPECIFICATION.md.

items.title: Migration fidelity gate blocks silent spec deletion when premigrate snapshot narratives lack canonical landing

narrative.Acceptance: Given specification.premigrate.xbrief.json with narratives not present in PROJECT-DEFINITION or scope vBRIEFs and no specification.xbrief.json, when verify-strategy-output runs, then it fails with actionable recovery guidance referencing #2005.

items.title: Python mirror surfaces stay aligned for maintainer task check paths

narrative.Acceptance: Given scripts/_precutover.py and scripts/validate_strategy_output.py, when run against the same fixtures as TS, then classification and fidelity outcomes match.

items.title: Consumer deposit githooks invoke Node deft only (no Python scripts/)

narrative.Acceptance: Given a Python-free 0.60.0-style consumer deposit (no scripts/), when git commit/push runs with core.hooksPath=.githooks, then branch/encoding/conformance/gh gates run via deft CLI; deft verify:hooks-installed passes; greenfield smoke succeeds with Python absent from PATH.
